svg.aria-label: Horizon blame pipeline architecture in six layers: gitea_repository feeds blame_capture, which feeds the pure parser blame_records; records load into blame_commits_table and blame_attribution_table; those two core tables fan out to eight independent feature families in PRs 5 through 12, which converge into the member_profile mart in PR 13.
